items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the pointwise weakly associated criterion at source lines 684-699, label lemma-bourbaki-finite-type-general-base-at-point, whose proof occupies source lines 701-730. The proof is not a two line citation: its substance is the descent translation, namely the commutative surjective etale diagram, the point lifting, and the verification that each of the three spaces side conditions (weakly associated point of the tensor product, weakly associated point of G, relative assassin) translates to its scheme counterpart, plus the etale locality of flatness at a point. The final equivalence itself is the scheme case lemma. The counted statement records none of the descent translation.
